body: filemark has TWO markdown pipelines. Main = MDXViewer (full plugin chain). Second = packages/mdx-viewer/src/components/TaskDetailSheet.tsx, a portal re-parsing a task's detail substring with [remarkGfm,remarkMath,remarkBreaks,remarkCodeMeta]+[rehypeRaw,rehypeSlug,rehypeKatex] — deliberately WITHOUT rehypeGlossary (line-offset complexity, acceptable for v1). It reuses the main components map via useMDXComponents() so fenced/MDX components still render inside task details.
